notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market SaaS vendor building product search and recommendation for SMB customers. Heavy on embedding ops: nightly batch indexing, incremental updates, and realtime search for user queries. Evaluation path: hosted API for dev/PoC -> dedicated reserved capacity for production.

Key decision makers: CTO (Sara Voss), Head of ML (Diego Alvarez), Platform/Product lead (Nina Rao). They care about throughput, predictable unit costs, and RBAC/SSO. Not highly regulated but want EU residency for EU customer subset (GDPR controls).

Shorthand from calls: 'we need ~2k qps at peak for vector lookup across 50M vectors, nightly reindex within 3 hours, and embedding batch job throughput 100k texts/hour' — Diego.

Notes style: fragments, priorities up-front, technical items lower. See timeline for activity log.

technical_requirements:
Primary: embeddings (multi-lingual), ANN search at low latency (avg <30ms 95p for topK=10), nightly batch indexing for 50M vectors to complete within 3 hours, incremental update window <5m for customer-facing content.
Integration: must work with their vector DB (currently evaluating Milvus and Pinecone); need official connector or tight SDK examples for streaming/upserts.
Throughput: baseline 1k qps sustained with 2k-4k qps burst. Cost sensitivity: want per-token/embedding unit clarity and predictable Dedicated pricing with committed monthly throughput.
Monitoring: per-route latency, per-key cost, token breakdowns, and anomaly alerts for embedding regressions.
Security: SSO, audit logs, customer-managed KMS, EU data residency for subset of data.
Misc: wants to pin model version and automatic fallback route to lighter models when capacity constrained.
poc_summary:
Hosted POC (2 weeks) completed with engineering sandbox: succeeded on small dataset (1.2M vectors). Observations: SDK onboarding excellent; prefix caching reduced calls for repeated queries. Metrics captured: avg latency 22ms for topK=10 on hosted test harness (<30ms target), embedding throughput 80k texts/hour on default batch settings (short of 100k target).
Next: Dedicated throughput demo to validate 2k-4k qps and nightly bulk ingest time. Need to run full-scale ingest (50M vectors) on Dedicated or simulate via parallel batch jobs. SE will provide a connector runbook for Milvus + Redwood.
Risks: hosted POC doesn't prove long-term cost model at scale; dedicated pricing and burst policy must be validated. Also need explicit SLOs for EU residency and audit log retention.
pricing_summary:
Preliminary pricing presented: hosted API dev tier (metered) for POC; Dedicated reserved plan estimates: $7k/month base + $0.018 per 1k embedding units (example) with bursting add-on. Customer asked for committed throughput tier pricing with clear overage caps. Procurement team is assembling TCO for 24-month commit.
Action: send scenario-based pricing (monthly commit vs pay-as-you-go) and include burst cost examples and preferred discounts for MRR commit.
